Elyx assets and data imports

Read bundled assets and convert them for Android UI.

Read files

Look up an asset through elyx.assets and use content_bytes(), content_string(), content_json() or content_yaml(). Wrappers can provide Android drawables or Telegram image locations.

Temporary assets

Asset.temp_asset_from_url(url, filename) uses HTTPS and the network capability. Call it on a worker and treat the returned file as generation-scoped cache data.
